description: Chiggi Patches v1.15.0 — adds three Android TV OTT apps. JioHotstar (in.startv.hotstar 26.06.22.3): Bypass proxy/VPN security block (novel NET_201 client-proxy-verdict bypass + refresh-loop fix so an India VPN works with no 'secure connection' error), Remove ads (SSAI ssaiTag cleared + banner render hidden), Spoof device-integrity self-report, Disable analytics, Remove AD_ID, Premium unlock (UI), Enable screenshots/screen-mirroring/all-codecs+4K/HDR10, Change app name. Vi Movies and TV (com.vimtv 10.8, YuppTV): Remove ads (IMA CSAI + SSAI via AdUrlResponse.getAdUrlTypes null + isAdEnabled false), Disable analytics, Remove AD_ID, Change app name, Premium unlock (UI). JioTV+ (com.jio.media.jiotvplus 2.6.4_2076): Remove ads (JioAds JioAdView + player VMAPAdsHelper.fetchAds), Disable analytics, Remove AD_ID, Change app name. All three are native TV builds with clean re-signing (no anti-tamper). Existing apps unchanged: SonyLIV (com.sonyliv 6.23.1), Nutrilio (net.nutrilio 1.20.2), Threads (com.instagram.barcelona 434.0.0.41.74), Arrow Puzzle (com.easybrain.arrow.puzzle.game 1.7.0), CrazyGames (com.crazygames.crazygamesapp 1.6.7).
